verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs say users can run their own fine-tuned weights on a dedicated autoscaling instance with a private endpoint. That directly addresses serving custom weights, but the evidence is only short marketing-level statements with no detail on how upload works. Missing for 10: documented upload workflow and supported weight formats/architectures, explicit LoRA adapter support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters

citations.quote: Need to run your own fine-tuned weights, or require data isolation? Deploy a dedicated instance on A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 with autoscaling and a private endpoint
